caption:
⚡️ The Silkway Accelerator program was launched by Astana Hub, in partnership with Google for Startups. It's aimed to help the 15 best startups to boost their projects.
⠀
In total, 237 applications were submitted from technological projects from Central Asia, as well as from Azerbaijan and Mongolia. The projects were evaluated by a special commission, which included experts from Central Asian countries and representatives of Google developers.
⠀
🔥 Participants will receive free master classes and mentoring from top Google experts. They will also learn how to effectively build their business processes, scale up, network with partners, and prepare for fundraising.
⠀
❗️Check out the list of winners in the pictures. To learn more about the Silkway Accelerator program, please follow the link in the profile description (taplink).
